record.notes: A draft amendment was published for consultation on 22 Oct 2025. The final rules were notified by MeitY on 10 Feb 2026 as G.S.R. 120(E) and took effect on 20 Feb 2026. The rules follow MeitY's non-binding AI advisories to intermediaries of 1 Mar 2024 (revised 15 Mar 2024, which dropped a prior-approval requirement for 'under-tested' models); those advisories are not separately recorded. A further draft amendment to the IT Rules was published on 30 Mar 2026 with comments open until 16 April 2026; it would make compliance with MeitY advisories part of intermediaries' due diligence. It was still a draft when last reported.

verification.note: Stored: MeitY consolidated IT Rules 2021 (updated as on 10.02.2026), which cites G.S.R. 120(E) of 10.02.2026 for the SGI definition (rule 2(1)(wa)), the labelling duties, the SSMI declaration duty (rule 4(1A)) and the three-hour and two-hour timelines. The 20 Feb 2026 commencement and the amendment's own title rest on a TeamLease RegTech summary of the notification (secondary); the consolidated text does not state them. The draft of 22 Oct 2025, the advisories of March 2024 and the revised second draft of 21 Apr 2026 were not confirmed from a stored source; the 30 Mar 2026 draft rests on a law-firm note (secondary).

judgment.status_reasoning: Consolidated rules updated as on 10.02.2026 contain the inserted SGI provisions; the notification text states the amendments come into force on 20 February 2026, which is before today (2026-10-18). Status In force stands. A later draft amendment is not adopted.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Binding rules on AI-generated content labelling and takedown; clearly in scope as an implementing rule.
